cues.en: video to explore what happens when we manipulate the attention heads across all the layers of the model,

cues.en: whether it matters which tokens we ablate and whether it matters if we set the attention head value to zero or some other value.

cues.en: So there's a lot to do here.
cues.zh: 所以，這裡有很多事情要做。

cues.en: Let's get started.

cues.en: A lot of exercise.

cues.en: One can be solved by copying and pasting code from the previous video.
cues.zh: 一有很多部分，可以複製貼上上一支影片的程式碼完成。

cues.en: The biggest change is to the hook function.
cues.zh: 最大改變，是 hook 函數。

cues.en: In the previous video, I hardcoded the function so that it would only hook into exactly one layer.
cues.zh: 上一支影片，我把函數寫死，只掛接一個特定層。

cues.en: Now here in exercise one, you want to hook into every layer and be able to specify which layer you want to manipulate, not only which head.
cues.zh: 現在練習一，要掛接每一層，除了指定操作哪個頭，也能指定操作哪一層。

cues.en: So to be clear, you want to be able to manipulate any head in any layer.
cues.zh: 說清楚，就是能操作任何層中的任何注意力頭。

cues.en: That's one change from the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是與上一支影片的一項差異。

cues.en: Another change is that you want to be able to choose whether to replace the activations in a given head
cues.zh: 另一項差異，是能選擇，要把某個頭的活化替換成

cues.en: with all zeros, or the average activation value in that head.
cues.zh: 全零，還是那個頭的平均活化值。

cues.en: So you will need another variable to toggle that choice.
cues.zh: 所以，需要另一個變數，切換這個選擇。

cues.en: The third change from the previous video is that you want to calculate the average activation, and store that as a variable that we can analyze later.
cues.zh: 第三項差異，是計算平均活化，儲存成稍後可分析的變數。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So just to make sure this is really clear, in the previous video I hardcoded the hook function to replace a given head activation with zeros.
cues.zh: 再確認一次，上一支影片的 hook 函數，寫死為將某個頭的活化替換成零。

cues.en: And what you are going to do here is first calculate the actual average of the activations in a given head in a given layer.
cues.zh: 這裡要先計算特定層、特定頭的實際平均活化。

cues.en: That's done before you do any manipulations.
cues.zh: 在做任何操作之前計算。

cues.en: And then you store that average value in a variable.
cues.zh: 再把平均值存成變數。

cues.en: And depending on the state of this toggle, you would then replace the attention head with zeros or with that average value.
cues.zh: 根據這個切換設定，再用零或那個平均值，替換注意力頭。

cues.en: Now, because all of this is done inside a function, any variables you create inside this function
cues.zh: 因為這些都在函數內完成，所以，在函數內建立的任何變數，

cues.en: only live inside the function and are deleted once that function finishes running.
cues.zh: 都只存在於函數內，函數執行結束後就刪除。

cues.en: And that is because functions have local scope.
cues.zh: 這是因為函數有區域作用域。

cues.en: So to be able to access the average from outside the function, you need to define the variable as a global variable before the function is called.
cues.zh: 要在函數外存取平均值，就需要在函數呼叫前，將變數定義為全域變數。

cues.en: So if you're not sure how to do that, then don't worry about that part of the exercise.
